limitations: 12individuals11families,11clusteredvariants upstream alternative start codon. Author P/LP interpretation explicitly conditional on TRA2B being an established disease gene; strong cohort/function evidence is not independent clinical validation.

Dominant negative isoform competition supported by four patient cell blots (Id2,4,5,7), single patient5RNAseq and CHEK1splicing, and HEK cotransfection dose response. Gain of function independent of canonical isoform is explicitly not excluded; no causality animal model, neural assay, or treatment rescue.

Patient5RNA shows preserved transcript rather than NMD; canonical39kDa protein reduced and20kDa species elevated. Protein identity inferred from size/C-terminal vsN-terminal antibodies; no isoform-specific proteomics in paper. Figure5PSI88%controlvs56%patient5; HEK three biologicalreplicates and pairwise t tests.

Whole-gene haploinsufficiency may differ: mouse heterozygotes reportedly normal, DGVdeletions21supposedhealthy/1153 and DECIPHER455kbdeletion inherited asymptomaticparent. These are suggestive comparison, not proof every downstream variant/deletion benign.

Father/son labeling internal error: Results calls fatherId8/sonId9, but Fig4 and both S1sheets show Id8age4 inheritsfromId9age31. Methods11/12de novo conflicts with S1ten de novo, one inherited, oneundetermined. Mapped cases1,2,4,5,7all explicitlydenovo in S1.

S1Sheet1C9listsg.185926600del; S2B4listsg.185926601del for c.170+1del. Packet genomicHGVS601 and VCFpos599AC>A deleting600 reproduce competing source representations. Reference-sequence normalization not independently established. S1p.0 labels for startloss conflictwith expressed shortisoform and S2uncertainprotein nomenclature.
S1Id1c19C>TpGln7Ter is labeledframeshift in Sheet1B12 though it is nonsense. Figure2growth/ID legend and summary fractions have inconsistencies against text/S1; individualtable preferred.
